absorb.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
absorb.name: ABSORB

acid.desc: The foe is attacked with a spray of harsh acid. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
acid.name: ACID

acid_armor.desc: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.
acid_armor.name: ACID ARMOR

acid_spray.desc: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
acid_spray.name: ACID SPRAY

acrobatics.desc: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.
acrobatics.name: ACROBATICS

acupressure.desc: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its stats.
acupressure.name: ACUPRESSURE

aerial_ace.desc: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.
aerial_ace.name: AERIAL ACE

aeroblast.desc: A vortex of air is shot at the foe to inflict damage. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
aeroblast.name: AEROBLAST

after_you.desc: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
after_you.name: AFTER YOU

agility.desc: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. It sharply boosts the Speed stat.
agility.name: AGILITY

air_cutter.desc: The user launches razorlike wind to slash the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
air_cutter.name: AIR CUTTER

air_slash.desc: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. It may also make the target flinch.
air_slash.name: AIR SLASH

ally_switch.desc: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
ally_switch.name: ALLY SWITCH

amnesia.desc: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.
amnesia.name: AMNESIA

ancient_power.desc: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.
ancient_power.name: ANCIENTPOWER

aqua_cutter.desc: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
aqua_cutter.name: AQUA CUTTER

aqua_jet.desc: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.
aqua_jet.name: AQUA JET

aqua_ring.desc: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP on every turn.
aqua_ring.name: AQUA RING

aqua_tail.desc: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.
aqua_tail.name: AQUA TAIL

arm_thrust.desc: The user looses a flurry of open-palmed arm thrusts that hit two to five times in a row.
arm_thrust.name: ARM THRUST

aromatherapy.desc: The user releases a soothing scent that heals all status problems affecting the user’s party.
aromatherapy.name: AROMATHERAPY

aromatic_mist.desc: The user boosts the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.
aromatic_mist.name: AROMATIC MIST

assist.desc: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by other Pokémon in the party.
assist.name: ASSIST

assurance.desc: If the foe has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.
assurance.name: ASSURANCE

astonish.desc: The user attacks the foe while shouting in a startling fashion. It may also make the target flinch.
astonish.name: ASTONISH

attack_order.desc: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
attack_order.name: ATTACK ORDER

attract.desc: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.
attract.name: ATTRACT

aura_sphere.desc: The user looses a blast of aura power from deep within its body. This move is certain to hit.
aura_sphere.name: AURA SPHERE

aurora_beam.desc: The foe is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. It may also lower the target’s Attack stat.
aurora_beam.name: AURORA BEAM

aurora_veil.desc: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only when it is snowing.
aurora_veil.name: AURORA VEIL

autotomize.desc: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
autotomize.name: AUTOTOMIZE

avalanche.desc: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.
avalanche.name: AVALANCHE

axe_kick.desc: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.
axe_kick.name: AXE KICK

baby_doll_eyes.desc: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.
baby_doll_eyes.name: BABY DOLL EYES

barrage.desc: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times in a row.
barrage.name: BARRAGE

barrier.desc: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.
barrier.name: BARRIER

baton_pass.desc: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, passing along any stat changes.
baton_pass.name: BATON PASS

beat_up.desc: The user gets all the party Pokémon to attack the foe. The more party Pokémon, the more damage.
beat_up.name: BEAT UP

belch.desc: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
belch.name: BELCH

belly_drum.desc: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.
belly_drum.name: BELLY DRUM

bide.desc: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.
bide.name: BIDE

bind.desc: A long body or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the foe for two to five turns.
bind.name: BIND

bite.desc: The foe is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. It may make the target flinch.
bite.name: BITE

blast_burn.desc: The foe is razed by a fiery explosion. The user must rest on the next turn, however.
blast_burn.name: BLAST BURN

blaze_kick.desc: The user launches a kick with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also leave the target with a burn.
blaze_kick.name: BLAZE KICK

blizzard.desc: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike the foe. It may also freeze the target solid.
blizzard.name: BLIZZARD

block.desc: The user blocks the foe’s way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.
block.name: BLOCK

body_press.desc: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
body_press.name: BODY PRESS

body_slam.desc: The user drops onto the foe with its full body weight. It may leave the foe paralyzed.
body_slam.name: BODY SLAM

bone_club.desc: The user clubs the foe with a bone. It may also make the target flinch.
bone_club.name: BONE CLUB

bone_rush.desc: The user strikes at the foe with a hard bone two to five times in a row.
bone_rush.name: BONE RUSH

bonemerang.desc: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops to hit the foe twice, coming and going.
bonemerang.name: BONEMERANG

boomburst.desc: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.
boomburst.name: BOOMBURST

bounce.desc: The user bounces up high, then drops on the foe on the second turn. It may also paralyze the foe.
bounce.name: BOUNCE

brave_bird.desc: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. The user also takes serious damage.
brave_bird.name: BRAVE BIRD

brick_break.desc: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.
brick_break.name: BRICK BREAK

brine.desc: If the foe’s HP is down to about half, this attack will hit with double the power.
brine.name: BRINE

bubble.desc: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.
bubble.name: BUBBLE

bubble_beam.desc: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Speed stat.
bubble_beam.name: BUBBLEBEAM

bug_bite.desc: The user bites the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
bug_bite.name: BUG BITE

bug_buzz.desc: The user vibrates its wings to generate a damaging sound wave. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.
bug_buzz.name: BUG BUZZ

bulk_up.desc: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.
bulk_up.name: BULK UP

bulldoze.desc: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.
bulldoze.name: BULLDOZE

bullet_punch.desc: The user strikes with a tough punch as fast as a bullet. This move always goes first.
bullet_punch.name: BULLET PUNCH

bullet_seed.desc: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.
bullet_seed.name: BULLET SEED

calm_mind.desc: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
calm_mind.name: CALM MIND

camouflage.desc: The user’s type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water’s edge, in grass, or in a cave.
camouflage.name: CAMOUFLAGE

captivate.desc: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.
captivate.name: CAPTIVATE

charge.desc: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses next. It also raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.
charge.name: CHARGE

charge_beam.desc: The user fires a concentrated bundle of electricity. It may also raise the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
charge_beam.name: CHARGE BEAM

charm.desc: The user charmingly stares at the foe, making it less wary. The target’s Attack is sharply lowered.
charm.name: CHARM

chatter.desc: The user attacks using a sound wave based on words it has learned. It may also confuse the foe.
chatter.name: CHATTER

clamp.desc: The foe is clamped and squeezed by the user’s very thick and sturdy shell for two to five turns.
clamp.name: CLAMP

clear_smog.desc: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.
clear_smog.name: CLEAR SMOG

close_combat.desc: The user fights the foe in close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.
close_combat.name: CLOSE COMBAT

coil.desc: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.
coil.name: COIL

comet_punch.desc: The foe is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.
comet_punch.name: COMET PUNCH

comeuppance.desc: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
comeuppance.name: COMEUPPANCE

confide.desc: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
confide.name: CONFIDE

confuse_ray.desc: The foe is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.
confuse_ray.name: CONFUSE RAY

confusion.desc: The foe is hit by a weak telekinetic force. It may also leave the foe confused.
confusion.name: CONFUSION

constrict.desc: The foe is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. It may also lower the target’s Speed.
constrict.name: CONSTRICT

conversion.desc: The user changes its type to become the same type as one of its moves.
conversion.name: CONVERSION

conversion_2.desc: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack it last took.
conversion_2.name: CONVERSION 2

copycat.desc: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.
copycat.name: COPYCAT

cosmic_power.desc: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
cosmic_power.name: COSMIC POWER

cotton_guard.desc: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.
cotton_guard.name: COTTON GUARD

cotton_spore.desc: The user releases cottonlike spores that cling to the foe, sharply reducing its Speed stat.
cotton_spore.name: COTTON SPORE

counter.desc: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.
counter.name: COUNTER

covet.desc: The user endearingly approaches the foe, then steals the item the foe is holding.
covet.name: COVET

crabhammer.desc: The foe is hammered with a large pincer. This move has a high critical-hit ratio.
crabhammer.name: CRABHAMMER

cross_chop.desc: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
cross_chop.name: CROSS CHOP

cross_poison.desc: A slashing attack that may also leave the target poisoned. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
cross_poison.name: CROSS POISON

crunch.desc: The user crunches up the foe with sharp fangs. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
crunch.name: CRUNCH

crush_claw.desc: The user slashes the foe with hard and sharp claws. It may also lower the target’s Defense.
crush_claw.name: CRUSH CLAW

crush_grip.desc: The foe is crushed with great force. The attack is more powerful the more HP the foe has left.
crush_grip.name: CRUSH GRIP

curse.desc: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all the other types.
curse.name: CURSE

cut.desc: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.
cut.name: CUT

dark_pulse.desc: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. It may also make the target flinch.
dark_pulse.name: DARK PULSE

dark_void.desc: The foe is dragged into a world of total darkness that puts it to sleep.
dark_void.name: DARK VOID

dazzling_gleam.desc: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.
dazzling_gleam.name: DAZZLING GLEAM

defend_order.desc: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
defend_order.name: DEFEND ORDER

defense_curl.desc: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.
defense_curl.name: DEFENSE CURL

defog.desc: Obstacles are moved, reducing the foe’s evasion stat. It can also be used to clear deep fog, etc.
defog.name: DEFOG

destiny_bond.desc: When this move is used, if the user faints, the foe that landed the knockout hit also faints.
destiny_bond.name: DESTINY BOND

detect.desc: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
detect.name: DETECT

dig.desc: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.
dig.name: DIG

disable.desc: For several turns, this move prevents the foe from using the move it last used.
disable.name: DISABLE

disarming_voice.desc: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.
disarming_voice.name: DISARMING VOICE

discharge.desc: A flare of electricity is loosed to strike all Pokémon in battle. It may also cause paralysis.
discharge.name: DISCHARGE

dive.desc: A two-turn attack. The user dives underwater on the first turn, then hits on the next turn.
dive.name: DIVE

dizzy_punch.desc: The foe is hit with rhythmically launched punches that may also leave it confused.
dizzy_punch.name: DIZZY PUNCH

doom_desire.desc: Two turns after this move is used, the user blasts the foe with a concentrated bundle of light.
doom_desire.name: DOOM DESIRE

double_edge.desc: A reckless, life- risking tackle. It also damages the user by a fairly large amount, however.
double_edge.name: DOUBLE-EDGE

double_hit.desc: The user slams the foe with a tail, etc. The target is hit twice in a row.
double_hit.name: DOUBLE HIT

double_kick.desc: The foe is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.
double_kick.name: DOUBLE KICK

double_slap.desc: The foe is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.
double_slap.name: DOUBLESLAP

double_team.desc: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
double_team.name: DOUBLE TEAM

draco_meteor.desc: Comets are summoned down from the sky. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
draco_meteor.name: DRACO METEOR

dragon_ascent.desc: The user attacks the target by dropping out of the sky at high speed. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
dragon_ascent.name: DRAGON ASCENT

dragon_breath.desc: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. It may also paralyze the target.
dragon_breath.name: DRAGONBREATH

dragon_claw.desc: The user slashes the foe with huge, sharp claws.
dragon_claw.name: DRAGON CLAW

dragon_dance.desc: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.
dragon_dance.name: DRAGON DANCE

dragon_pulse.desc: The foe is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user’s gaping mouth.
dragon_pulse.name: DRAGON PULSE

dragon_rage.desc: The foe is stricken by a shock wave. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.
dragon_rage.name: DRAGON RAGE

dragon_rush.desc: The user tackles the foe while exhibiting overwhelming menace. It may also make the target flinch.
dragon_rush.name: DRAGON RUSH

dragon_tail.desc: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
dragon_tail.name: DRAGON TAIL

drain_punch.desc: An energy-draining punch. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
drain_punch.name: DRAIN PUNCH

draining_kiss.desc: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.
draining_kiss.name: DRAINING KISS

dream_eater.desc: An attack that works only on a sleeping foe. It absorbs half the damage caused to heal the user’s HP.
dream_eater.name: DREAM EATER

drill_peck.desc: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.
drill_peck.name: DRILL PECK

drill_run.desc: The user crashes into the target while rotating its body like a drill. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
drill_run.name: DRILL RUN

dual_chop.desc: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.
dual_chop.name: DUAL CHOP

dual_wingbeat.desc: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
dual_wingbeat.name: DUAL WINGBEAT

dynamic_punch.desc: The foe is punched with the user’s full, concentrated power. It confuses the foe if it hits.
dynamic_punch.name: DYNAMICPUNCH

earth_power.desc: The user makes the ground under the foe erupt with power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.
earth_power.name: EARTH POWER

earthquake.desc: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.
earthquake.name: EARTHQUAKE

echoed_voice.desc: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used consecutively by any Pokémon, its power is boosted.
echoed_voice.name: ECHOED VOICE

eerie_impulse.desc: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
eerie_impulse.name: EERIE IMPULSE

egg_bomb.desc: A large egg is hurled with maximum force at the foe to inflict damage.
egg_bomb.name: EGG BOMB

electric_terrain.desc: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.
electric_terrain.name: ELECTRIC TERRAIN

electro_ball.desc: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.
electro_ball.name: ELECTRO BALL

embargo.desc: It prevents the foe from using its held item. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.
embargo.name: EMBARGO

ember.desc: The foe is attacked with small flames. The target may also be left with a burn.
ember.name: EMBER

encore.desc: The user compels the foe to keep using only the move it last used for three to seven turns.
encore.name: ENCORE

endeavor.desc: An attack move that cuts down the foe’s HP to equal the user’s HP.
endeavor.name: ENDEAVOR

endure.desc: The user endures any attack, leaving 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
endure.name: ENDURE

energy_ball.desc: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.
energy_ball.name: ENERGY BALL

entrainment.desc: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.
entrainment.name: ENTRAINMENT

eruption.desc: The user attacks in an explosive fury. The lower the user’s HP, the less powerful this attack becomes.
eruption.name: ERUPTION

explosion.desc: The user explodes to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.
explosion.name: EXPLOSION

extrasensory.desc: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. It may also make the foe flinch.
extrasensory.name: EXTRASENSORY

extreme_speed.desc: The user charges the foe at blinding speed. This attack always goes before any other move.
extreme_speed.name: EXTREMESPEED

facade.desc: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.
facade.name: FACADE

faint_attack.desc: The user draws up to the foe disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. It hits without fail.
faint_attack.name: FAINT ATTACK

fairy_wind.desc: The user attacks by stirring up a fairy wind to strike the target.
fairy_wind.name: FAIRY WIND

fake_out.desc: An attack that hits first and makes the target flinch. This move works only on the first turn.
fake_out.name: FAKE OUT

fake_tears.desc: The user feigns crying to make the foe feel flustered, sharply lowering its Sp. Def stat.
fake_tears.name: FAKE TEARS

false_swipe.desc: A restrained attack that prevents the foe from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
false_swipe.name: FALSE SWIPE

feather_dance.desc: The user covers the foe with a mass of down that sharply lowers the Attack stat.
feather_dance.name: FEATHERDANCE

feint.desc: An attack that hits a foe using Protect or Detect. It also lifts the effects of those moves.
feint.name: FEINT

fell_stinger.desc: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat is boosted drastically.
fell_stinger.name: FELL STINGER

final_gambit.desc: The user risks everything to attack the target. The user faints but inflicts damage equal to its own HP.
final_gambit.name: FINAL GAMBIT

fire_blast.desc: The foe is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. It may also leave the target with a burn.
fire_blast.name: FIRE BLAST

fire_fang.desc: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or sustain a burn.
fire_fang.name: FIRE FANG

fire_punch.desc: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.
fire_punch.name: FIRE PUNCH

fire_spin.desc: The foe becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for two to five turns.
fire_spin.name: FIRE SPIN

fissure.desc: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the foe in. The target instantly faints if it hits.
fissure.name: FISSURE

flail.desc: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. It becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
flail.name: FLAIL

flame_charge.desc: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.
flame_charge.name: FLAME CHARGE

flame_wheel.desc: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. It may also leave the target with a burn.
flame_wheel.name: FLAME WHEEL

flamethrower.desc: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. The target may also be left with a burn.
flamethrower.name: FLAMETHROWER

flare_blitz.desc: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the foe. The user sustains serious damage, too.
flare_blitz.name: FLARE BLITZ

flash.desc: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.
flash.name: FLASH

flash_cannon.desc: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.
flash_cannon.name: FLASH CANNON

flatter.desc: Flattery is used to confuse the foe. However, it also raises the target’s Sp. Atk stat.
flatter.name: FLATTER

fling.desc: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.
fling.name: FLING

flower_shield.desc: The user raises the Defense stats of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.
flower_shield.name: FLOWER SHIELD

fly.desc: The user soars, then strikes on the second turn. It can also be used for flying to any familiar town.
fly.name: FLY

focus_blast.desc: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.
focus_blast.name: FOCUS BLAST

focus_energy.desc: The user takes a deep breath and focuses to raise the critical-hit ratio of its attacks.
focus_energy.name: FOCUS ENERGY

focus_punch.desc: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.
focus_punch.name: FOCUS PUNCH

follow_me.desc: The user draws attention to itself, making all foes take aim only at the user.
follow_me.name: FOLLOW ME

force_palm.desc: The foe is attacked with a shock wave. It may also leave the target paralyzed.
force_palm.name: FORCE PALM

foresight.desc: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.
foresight.name: FORESIGHT

foul_play.desc: The user turns the target's strength against it. The higher the target's Attack stat, the greater the damage this move inflicts.
foul_play.name: FOUL PLAY

freeze_dry.desc: The user rapidly cools the target. This may also leave the target frozen. This move is super effective on Water types.
freeze_dry.name: FREEZE DRY

frenzy_plant.desc: The foe is slammed with an enormous tree. The user can’t move on the next turn.
frenzy_plant.name: FRENZY PLANT

frost_breath.desc: The user attacks by blowing its cold breath on the target. This move always lands a critical hit.
frost_breath.name: FROST BREATH

frustration.desc: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.
frustration.name: FRUSTRATION

fury_attack.desc: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.
fury_attack.name: FURY ATTACK

fury_cutter.desc: The foe is slashed with scythes or claws. Its power increases if it hits in succession.
fury_cutter.name: FURY CUTTER

fury_swipes.desc: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.
fury_swipes.name: FURY SWIPES

future_sight.desc: Two turns after this move is used, the foe is attacked with a hunk of psychic energy.
future_sight.name: FUTURE SIGHT

gastro_acid.desc: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the foe. The fluid eliminates the effect of the foe’s ability.
gastro_acid.name: GASTRO ACID

giga_drain.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
giga_drain.name: GIGA DRAIN

giga_impact.desc: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.
giga_impact.name: GIGA IMPACT

glare.desc: The user intimidates the foe with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.
glare.name: GLARE

grass_knot.desc: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.
grass_knot.name: GRASS KNOT

grass_whistle.desc: The user plays a pleasant melody that lulls the foe into a deep sleep.
grass_whistle.name: GRASSWHISTLE

grassy_terrain.desc: The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.
grassy_terrain.name: GRASSY TERRAIN

gravity.desc: Gravity is intensified for five turns, making moves involving flying unusable and negating Levitation.
gravity.name: GRAVITY

growl.desc: The user growls in an endearing way, making the foe less wary. The target’s Attack stat is lowered.
growl.name: GROWL

growth.desc: The user’s body is forced to grow all at once. It raises the Sp. Atk stat.
growth.name: GROWTH

grudge.desc: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the foe’s move that knocked it out.
grudge.name: GRUDGE

guard_split.desc: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of the target.
guard_split.name: GUARD SPLIT

guard_swap.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def with the foe.
guard_swap.name: GUARD SWAP

guillotine.desc: A vicious, tearing attack with pincers. The foe will faint instantly if this attack hits.
guillotine.name: GUILLOTINE

gunk_shot.desc: The user shoots filthy garbage at the foe to attack. It may also poison the target.
gunk_shot.name: GUNK SHOT

gust.desc: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the foe to inflict damage.
gust.name: GUST

gyro_ball.desc: The user tackles the foe with a high-speed spin. The slower the user, the greater the damage.
gyro_ball.name: GYRO BALL

hail.desc: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except the Ice type.
hail.name: HAIL

hammer_arm.desc: The user swings and hits with its strong and heavy fist. It lowers the user’s Speed, however.
hammer_arm.name: HAMMER ARM

harden.desc: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.
harden.name: HARDEN

haze.desc: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
haze.name: HAZE

head_smash.desc: The user delivers a life-endangering head butt at full power. The user also takes terrible damage.
head_smash.name: HEAD SMASH

headbutt.desc: The user sticks its head out and rams straight forward. It may make the foe flinch.
headbutt.name: HEADBUTT

headlong_rush.desc: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
headlong_rush.name: HEADLONG RUSH

heal_bell.desc: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status problems of all the party Pokémon.
heal_bell.name: HEAL BELL

heal_block.desc: The user prevents the foe from using any HP-recovery moves for five turns.
heal_block.name: HEAL BLOCK

heal_order.desc: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.
heal_order.name: HEAL ORDER

heal_pulse.desc: The user emits a healing pulse that restores the target's HP by up to half its max HP.
heal_pulse.name: HEAL PULSE

healing_wish.desc: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status cured.
healing_wish.name: HEALING WISH

heart_swap.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the foe.
heart_swap.name: HEART SWAP

heat_wave.desc: The user exhales a heated breath on the foe to attack. It may also leave the target with a burn.
heat_wave.name: HEAT WAVE

heavy_slam.desc: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.
heavy_slam.name: HEAVY SLAM

helping_hand.desc: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a Double Battle.
helping_hand.name: HELPING HAND

hex.desc: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.
hex.name: HEX

hi_jump_kick.desc: The foe is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.
hi_jump_kick.name: HI JUMP KICK

hidden_power.desc: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.
hidden_power.name: HIDDEN POWER

high_horsepower.desc: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.
high_horsepower.name: HIGH HORSEPOWER

high_jump_kick.desc: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.
high_jump_kick.name: HIGH JUMP KICK

hone_claws.desc: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.
hone_claws.name: HONE CLAWS

horn_attack.desc: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
horn_attack.name: HORN ATTACK

horn_drill.desc: The foe is stabbed with a horn rotating like a drill. The foe instantly faints if it hits.
horn_drill.name: HORN DRILL

howl.desc: The user howls loudly to raise its spirit, boosting its Attack stat.
howl.name: HOWL

hurricane.desc: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind. This may also confuse the target.
hurricane.name: HURRICANE

hydro_cannon.desc: The foe is hit with a watery blast. The user must rest on the next turn, however.
hydro_cannon.name: HYDRO CANNON

hydro_pump.desc: The foe is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
hydro_pump.name: HYDRO PUMP

hyper_beam.desc: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.
hyper_beam.name: HYPER BEAM

hyper_drill.desc: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.
hyper_drill.name: HYPER DRILL

hyper_fang.desc: The user bites hard on the foe with its sharp front fangs. It may also make the target flinch.
hyper_fang.name: HYPER FANG

hyper_voice.desc: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.
hyper_voice.name: HYPER VOICE

hypnosis.desc: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.
hypnosis.name: HYPNOSIS

ice_ball.desc: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.
ice_ball.name: ICE BALL

ice_beam.desc: The foe is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. It may also freeze the target solid.
ice_beam.name: ICE BEAM

ice_fang.desc: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or freeze.
ice_fang.name: ICE FANG

ice_punch.desc: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the target frozen.
ice_punch.name: ICE PUNCH

ice_shard.desc: The user flash freezes chunks of ice and hurls them. This move always goes first.
ice_shard.name: ICE SHARD

icicle_crash.desc: The user attacks by crashing large icicles onto the target. This may also make the target flinch.
icicle_crash.name: ICICLE CRASH

icicle_spear.desc: The user launches sharp icicles at the foe. It strikes two to five times in a row.
icicle_spear.name: ICICLE SPEAR

icy_wind.desc: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. It also lowers the target’s Speed stat.
icy_wind.name: ICY WIND

imprison.desc: If the foe knows any move also known by the user, the foe is prevented from using it.
imprison.name: IMPRISON

incinerate.desc: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.
incinerate.name: INCINERATE

inferno.desc: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.
inferno.name: INFERNO

infestation.desc: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.
infestation.name: INFESTATION

ingrain.desc: The user lays roots that restore HP on every turn. Because it is rooted, it can’t switch out.
ingrain.name: INGRAIN

iron_defense.desc: The user hardens its body’s surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.
iron_defense.name: IRON DEFENSE

iron_head.desc: The foe slams the target with its steel-hard head. It may also make the target flinch.
iron_head.name: IRON HEAD

iron_tail.desc: The foe is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.
iron_tail.name: IRON TAIL

judgment.desc: The user releases countless shots of light. Its type varies with the kind of Plate the user is holding.
judgment.name: JUDGMENT

jump_kick.desc: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.
jump_kick.name: JUMP KICK

karate_chop.desc: The foe is attacked with a sharp chop. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
karate_chop.name: KARATE CHOP

kinesis.desc: The user distracts the foe by bending a spoon. It may lower the target’s accuracy.
kinesis.name: KINESIS

knock_off.desc: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.
knock_off.name: KNOCK OFF

laser_focus.desc: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.
laser_focus.name: LASER FOCUS

last_resort.desc: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.
last_resort.name: LAST RESORT

lava_plume.desc: An inferno of scarlet flames washes over all Pokémon in battle. It may also inflict burns.
lava_plume.name: LAVA PLUME

leaf_blade.desc: The foe is slashed with a sharp leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
leaf_blade.name: LEAF BLADE

leaf_storm.desc: A storm of sharp leaves is whipped up. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
leaf_storm.name: LEAF STORM

leaf_tornado.desc: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target’s accuracy.
leaf_tornado.name: LEAF TORNADO

leafage.desc: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.
leafage.name: LEAFAGE

leech_life.desc: A blood-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
leech_life.name: LEECH LIFE

leech_seed.desc: A seed is planted on the foe. It steals some HP from the foe to heal the user on every turn.
leech_seed.name: LEECH SEED

leer.desc: The foe is given an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target’s Defense stat is reduced.
leer.name: LEER

lick.desc: The foe is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. It may also paralyze the target.
lick.name: LICK

life_dew.desc: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
life_dew.name: LIFE DEW

light_screen.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from special attacks for five turns.
light_screen.name: LIGHT SCREEN

liquidation.desc: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
liquidation.name: LIQUIDATION

lock_on.desc: The user takes sure aim at the foe. It ensures the next attack does not fail to hit the target.
lock_on.name: LOCK-ON

lovely_kiss.desc: With a scary face, the user forces a kiss on the foe. It may make the target fall asleep.
lovely_kiss.name: LOVELY KISS

low_kick.desc: A powerful low kick that makes the foe fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier foes.
low_kick.name: LOW KICK

low_sweep.desc: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.
low_sweep.name: LOW SWEEP

lucky_chant.desc: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing the foe from landing critical hits.
lucky_chant.name: LUCKY CHANT

lunar_blessing.desc: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.
lunar_blessing.name: LUNAR BLESSING

lunar_dance.desc: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.
lunar_dance.name: LUNAR DANCE

lunge.desc: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
lunge.name: LUNGE

luster_purge.desc: The user looses a damaging burst of light. It may also reduce the target’s Sp. Def stat.
luster_purge.name: LUSTER PURGE

mach_punch.desc: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.
mach_punch.name: MACH PUNCH

magic_coat.desc: A barrier reflects back to the foe moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.
magic_coat.name: MAGIC COAT

magic_room.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.
magic_room.name: MAGIC ROOM

magical_leaf.desc: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the foe. This attack will not miss.
magical_leaf.name: MAGICAL LEAF

magma_storm.desc: The foe becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for two to five turns.
magma_storm.name: MAGMA STORM

magnet_bomb.desc: The user launches a steel bomb that sticks to the target. This attack will not miss.
magnet_bomb.name: MAGNET BOMB

magnet_rise.desc: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
magnet_rise.name: MAGNET RISE

magnetic_flux.desc: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus Ability or the Minus Ability.
magnetic_flux.name: MAGNETIC FLUX

magnitude.desc: The user looses a ground-shaking quake affecting everyone in battle. Its power varies.
magnitude.name: MAGNITUDE

me_first.desc: The user tries to cut ahead of the foe to steal and use the foe’s intended move with greater power.
me_first.name: ME FIRST

mean_look.desc: The user affixes the foe with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
mean_look.name: MEAN LOOK

meditate.desc: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.
meditate.name: MEDITATE

mega_drain.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
mega_drain.name: MEGA DRAIN

mega_kick.desc: The foe is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.
mega_kick.name: MEGA KICK

mega_punch.desc: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
mega_punch.name: MEGA PUNCH

megahorn.desc: Utilizing its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the foe  with no letup.
megahorn.name: MEGAHORN

memento.desc: The user faints upon using this move. In return, it sharply lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk.
memento.name: MEMENTO

metal_burst.desc: The user retaliates against the foe that last inflicted damage on it with much greater power.
metal_burst.name: METAL BURST

metal_claw.desc: The foe is raked with steel claws. It may also raise the user’s Attack stat.
metal_claw.name: METAL CLAW

metal_sound.desc: A horrible sound like scraping metal is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.
metal_sound.name: METAL SOUND

meteor_mash.desc: The foe is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. It may also raise the user’s Attack.
meteor_mash.name: METEOR MASH

metronome.desc: The user waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into randomly using nearly any move.
metronome.name: METRONOME

milk_drink.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. It may also be used to heal an ally’s HP.
milk_drink.name: MILK DRINK

mimic.desc: The user copies the move last used by the foe. The move can be used for the rest of the battle.
mimic.name: MIMIC

mind_reader.desc: The user senses the foe’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss.
mind_reader.name: MIND READER

minimize.desc: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller. The user’s evasion stat is boosted.
minimize.name: MINIMIZE

miracle_eye.desc: Enables the user to hit a Dark type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.
miracle_eye.name: MIRACLE EYE

mirror_coat.desc: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.
mirror_coat.name: MIRROR COAT

mirror_move.desc: The user counters the foe by mimicking the move last used by the foe.
mirror_move.name: MIRROR MOVE

mirror_shot.desc: The user looses a flash of energy from its polished body. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.
mirror_shot.name: MIRROR SHOT

mist.desc: The user cloaks its body with a white mist that prevents any of its stats from being cut for five turns.
mist.name: MIST

mist_ball.desc: A mistlike flurry of down envelops and damages the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Atk.
mist_ball.name: MIST BALL

misty_terrain.desc: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.
misty_terrain.name: MISTY TERRAIN

moonblast.desc: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.
moonblast.name: MOONBLAST

moonlight.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
moonlight.name: MOONLIGHT

morning_sun.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
morning_sun.name: MORNING SUN

mud_bomb.desc: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.
mud_bomb.name: MUD BOMB

mud_shot.desc: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the foe. It also reduces the target’s Speed.
mud_shot.name: MUD SHOT

mud_slap.desc: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
mud_slap.name: MUD-SLAP

mud_sport.desc: The user covers itself with mud. It weakens Electric- type moves while the user is in the battle.
mud_sport.name: MUD SPORT

muddy_water.desc: The user attacks by shooting out muddy water. It may also lower the foe’s accuracy.
muddy_water.name: MUDDY WATER

mystical_fire.desc: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
mystical_fire.name: MYSTICAL FIRE

mystical_power.desc: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
mystical_power.name: MYSTICAL POWER

nasty_plot.desc: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. It sharply raises the user’s Sp. Atk.
nasty_plot.name: NASTY PLOT

natural_gift.desc: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.
natural_gift.name: NATURAL GIFT

nature_power.desc: An attack that makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.
nature_power.name: NATURE POWER

needle_arm.desc: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. It may also make the target flinch.
needle_arm.name: NEEDLE ARM

night_shade.desc: The user makes the foe see a mirage. It inflicts damage matching the user’s level.
night_shade.name: NIGHT SHADE

night_slash.desc: The user slashes the foe the instant an opportunity arises. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
night_slash.name: NIGHT SLASH

nightmare.desc: A sleeping foe is shown a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.
nightmare.name: NIGHTMARE

noble_roar.desc: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
noble_roar.name: NOBLE ROAR

nuzzle.desc: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.
nuzzle.name: NUZZLE

octazooka.desc: The user attacks by spraying ink in the foe’s face or eyes. It may also lower the target’s accuracy.
octazooka.name: OCTAZOOKA

odor_sleuth.desc: Enables the user to hit a Ghost type with any type of move. It also enables the user to hit an evasive foe.
odor_sleuth.name: ODOR SLEUTH

ominous_wind.desc: The user creates a gust of repulsive wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.
ominous_wind.name: OMINOUS WIND

origin_pulse.desc: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.
origin_pulse.name: ORIGIN PULSE

outrage.desc: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. However, it then becomes confused.
outrage.name: OUTRAGE

overheat.desc: The user attacks the foe at full power. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
overheat.name: OVERHEAT

pain_split.desc: The user adds its HP to the foe’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the foe.
pain_split.name: PAIN SPLIT

parting_shot.desc: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
parting_shot.name: PARTING SHOT

pay_day.desc: Numerous coins are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. Money is earned after battle.
pay_day.name: PAY DAY

payback.desc: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.
payback.name: PAYBACK

peck.desc: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.
peck.name: PECK

perish_song.desc: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns unless it switches out of battle.
perish_song.name: PERISH SONG

petal_blizzard.desc: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and damages everything around it.
petal_blizzard.name: PETAL BLIZZARD

petal_dance.desc: The user attacks by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
petal_dance.name: PETAL DANCE

phantom_force.desc: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
phantom_force.name: PHANTOM FORCE

pin_missile.desc: Sharp pins are shot at the foe in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.
pin_missile.name: PIN MISSILE

play_nice.desc: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target's Attack stat.
play_nice.name: PLAY NICE

play_rough.desc: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
play_rough.name: PLAY ROUGH

pluck.desc: The user pecks the foe. If the foe is holding a Berry, the user plucks it and gains its effect.
pluck.name: PLUCK

poison_fang.desc: The user bites the foe with toxic fangs. It may also leave the foe badly poisoned.
poison_fang.name: POISON FANG

poison_gas.desc: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the foe’s face. It may poison the target.
poison_gas.name: POISON GAS

poison_jab.desc: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.
poison_jab.name: POISON JAB

poison_powder.desc: A cloud of poisonous dust is scattered on the foe. It may poison the target.
poison_powder.name: POISONPOWDER

poison_sting.desc: The foe is stabbed with a poisonous barb of some sort. It may also poison the target.
poison_sting.name: POISON STING

poison_tail.desc: An attack with a high critical-hit ratio. This tail  attack may also  poison the foe.
poison_tail.name: POISON TAIL

pound.desc: The foe is physically pounded with a long tail or a foreleg, etc.
pound.name: POUND

powder_snow.desc: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. It may also freeze the target.
powder_snow.name: POWDER SNOW

power_gem.desc: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.
power_gem.name: POWER GEM

power_split.desc: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.
power_split.name: POWER SPLIT

power_swap.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk with the foe.
power_swap.name: POWER SWAP

power_trick.desc: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack with its Defense stat.
power_trick.name: POWER TRICK

power_trip.desc: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.
power_trip.name: POWER TRIP

power_whip.desc: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the foe.
power_whip.name: POWER WHIP

precipice_blades.desc: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.
precipice_blades.name: PRECIPICE BLADES

present.desc: The user attacks by giving the foe a booby-trapped gift. It restores HP sometimes, however.
present.name: PRESENT

protect.desc: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
protect.name: PROTECT

psybeam.desc: The foe is attacked with a peculiar ray. It may also leave the target confused.
psybeam.name: PSYBEAM

psych_up.desc: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.
psych_up.name: PSYCH UP

psychic.desc: The foe is hit by a strong telekinetic force. It may also reduce the foe’s Sp. Def stat.
psychic.name: PSYCHIC

psycho_boost.desc: The user attacks the foe at full power. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
psycho_boost.name: PSYCHO BOOST

psycho_cut.desc: The user tears at the foe with blades formed by psychic power. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
psycho_cut.name: PSYCHO CUT

psycho_shift.desc: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status problems to the target.
psycho_shift.name: PSYCHO SHIFT

psyshock.desc: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.
psyshock.name: PSYSHOCK

psystrike.desc: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.
psystrike.name: PSYSTRIKE

psywave.desc: The foe is attacked with an odd, hot energy wave. The attack varies in intensity.
psywave.name: PSYWAVE

punishment.desc: This attack’s power increases the more the foe has powered up with stat changes.
punishment.name: PUNISHMENT

pursuit.desc: An attack move that inflicts double damage if used on a foe that is switching out of battle.
pursuit.name: PURSUIT

quash.desc: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
quash.name: QUASH

quick_attack.desc: The user lunges at the foe at a speed that makes it almost invisible. It is sure to strike first.
quick_attack.name: QUICK ATTACK

quick_guard.desc: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.
quick_guard.name: QUICK GUARD

quiver_dance.desc: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
quiver_dance.name: QUIVER DANCE

rage.desc: While this move is in use, it gains attack power each time the user is hit in battle.
rage.name: RAGE

rage_fist.desc: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.
rage_fist.name: RAGE FIST

rage_powder.desc: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opposing Pokémon aim only at the user.
rage_powder.name: RAGE POWDER

raging_bull.desc: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
raging_bull.name: RAGING BULL

raging_fury.desc: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
raging_fury.name: RAGING FURY

rain_dance.desc: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.
rain_dance.name: RAIN DANCE

rapid_spin.desc: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.
rapid_spin.name: RAPID SPIN

razor_leaf.desc: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
razor_leaf.name: RAZOR LEAF

razor_shell.desc: The user cuts the target with sharp shells to inflict damage. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
razor_shell.name: RAZOR SHELL

razor_wind.desc: A two-turn attack. Blades of wind hit the foe on the second turn. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
razor_wind.name: RAZOR WIND

recover.desc: A self-healing move. The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.
recover.name: RECOVER

recycle.desc: The user recycles a single-use item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.
recycle.name: RECYCLE

reflect.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.
reflect.name: REFLECT

reflect_type.desc: The user reflects the target's type to become the same type as the target.
reflect_type.name: REFLECT TYPE

refresh.desc: The user rests to cure itself of a poisoning, burn, or paralysis.
refresh.name: REFRESH

rest.desc: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.
rest.name: REST

retaliate.desc: The user takes revenge for a fainted ally. This move's power is boosted if an ally fainted in the previous turn.
retaliate.name: RETALIATE

return.desc: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.
return.name: RETURN

revenge.desc: An attack move that inflicts double the damage if the user has been hurt by the foe in the same turn.
revenge.name: REVENGE

reversal.desc: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
reversal.name: REVERSAL

roar.desc: The foe is scared off, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
roar.name: ROAR

roar_of_time.desc: The user blasts the foe with power that distorts even time. The user must rest on the next turn.
roar_of_time.name: ROAR OF TIME

rock_blast.desc: The user hurls hard rocks at the foe. Two to five rocks are launched in quick succession.
rock_blast.name: ROCK BLAST

rock_climb.desc: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.
rock_climb.name: ROCK CLIMB

rock_polish.desc: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. It can sharply raise the Speed stat.
rock_polish.name: ROCK POLISH

rock_slide.desc: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.
rock_slide.name: ROCK SLIDE

rock_smash.desc: The user slugs the foe with a shattering punch. It can also smash cracked boulders.
rock_smash.name: ROCK SMASH

rock_throw.desc: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the foe to attack.
rock_throw.name: ROCK THROW

rock_tomb.desc: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed by preventing its movement.
rock_tomb.name: ROCK TOMB

rock_wrecker.desc: The user launches a huge boulder at the foe to attack. It must rest on the next turn, however.
rock_wrecker.name: ROCK WRECKER

role_play.desc: The user mimics the foe completely, copying the foe’s natural ability.
role_play.name: ROLE PLAY

rolling_kick.desc: The user cuts a quick spin and lashes out with a sharp kick.
rolling_kick.name: ROLLING KICK

rollout.desc: The user continually rolls into the foe over five turns. It becomes stronger each time it hits.
rollout.name: ROLLOUT

roost.desc: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user’s HP by up to half of its max HP.
roost.name: ROOST

round.desc: The user attacks the target with a song. If others use this move, they will act immediately after the initial user, and the power of their Rounds will be boosted.
round.name: ROUND

sacred_fire.desc: The foe is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. It may also leave the target with a burn.
sacred_fire.name: SACRED FIRE

sacred_sword.desc: The user attacks by slicing with a sword. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.
sacred_sword.name: SACRED SWORD

safeguard.desc: The user creates a protective field that prevents status problems for five turns.
safeguard.name: SAFEGUARD

sand_attack.desc: Sand is hurled in the foe’s face, reducing its accuracy.
sand_attack.name: SAND-ATTACK

sand_tomb.desc: The user traps the foe inside a harshly raging sandstorm for two to five turns.
sand_tomb.name: SAND TOMB

sandstorm.desc: A five-turn sand- storm is summoned to hurt all combatant types except Rock,  Ground, and Steel.
sandstorm.name: SANDSTORM

scary_face.desc: The user frightens the foe with a scary face to sharply reduce its Speed stat.
scary_face.name: SCARY FACE

scratch.desc: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe to inflict damage.
scratch.name: SCRATCH

screech.desc: An earsplitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Defense stat.
screech.name: SCREECH

secret_power.desc: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.
secret_power.name: SECRET POWER

seed_bomb.desc: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.
seed_bomb.name: SEED BOMB

seed_flare.desc: The user generates a shock wave from within its body. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.
seed_flare.name: SEED FLARE

seismic_toss.desc: The foe is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.
seismic_toss.name: SEISMIC TOSS

selfdestruct.desc: The user blows up to inflict damage on all Pokémon in battle. The user faints upon using this move.
selfdestruct.name: SELFDESTRUCT

shadow_ball.desc: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the foe. It may also lower the foe’s Sp. Def stat.
shadow_ball.name: SHADOW BALL

shadow_claw.desc: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
shadow_claw.name: SHADOW CLAW

shadow_force.desc: The user disappears, then strikes the foe on the second turn. It hits even if the foe used Protect.
shadow_force.name: SHADOW FORCE

shadow_punch.desc: The user throws a punch at the foe from the shadows. The punch lands without fail.
shadow_punch.name: SHADOW PUNCH

shadow_sneak.desc: The user extends its shadow and attacks the foe from behind. This move always goes first.
shadow_sneak.name: SHADOW SNEAK

sharpen.desc: The user reduces its polygon count to make itself more jagged, raising the Attack stat.
sharpen.name: SHARPEN

sheer_cold.desc: The foe is attacked with a blast of absolute-zero cold. The foe instantly faints if it hits.
sheer_cold.name: SHEER COLD

shell_smash.desc: The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
shell_smash.name: SHELL SMASH

shock_wave.desc: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.
shock_wave.name: SHOCK WAVE

signal_beam.desc: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. It may also confuse the target.
signal_beam.name: SIGNAL BEAM

silver_wind.desc: The foe is attacked with powdery scales blown by wind. It may also raise all the user’s stats.
silver_wind.name: SILVER WIND

simple_beam.desc: The user emits a mysterious psychic wave that changes the target's Ability to Simple.
simple_beam.name: SIMPLE BEAM

sing.desc: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the foe into a deep slumber.
sing.name: SING

sketch.desc: It enables the user to learn a move used by the foe. Once used, the move Sketch disappears.
sketch.name: SKETCH

skill_swap.desc: The user employs its psychic power to exchange abilities with the foe.
skill_swap.name: SKILL SWAP

skull_bash.desc: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense in the first turn, then rams the foe on the next turn.
skull_bash.name: SKULL BASH

sky_attack.desc: A second-turn attack move with a high critical-hit ratio. It may also make the target flinch.
sky_attack.name: SKY ATTACK

sky_uppercut.desc: The user attacks the foe with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.
sky_uppercut.name: SKY UPPERCUT

slack_off.desc: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP.
slack_off.name: SLACK OFF

slam.desc: The foe is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.
slam.name: SLAM

slash.desc: The foe is attacked with a slash of claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
slash.name: SLASH

sleep_powder.desc: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep- inducing dust around the foe.
sleep_powder.name: SLEEP POWDER

sleep_talk.desc: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.
sleep_talk.name: SLEEP TALK

sludge.desc: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the foe. It may also poison the target.
sludge.name: SLUDGE

sludge_bomb.desc: The user attacks by hurling filthy sludge at the foe. It may also poison the target.
sludge_bomb.name: SLUDGE BOMB

sludge_wave.desc: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those it hits.
sludge_wave.name: SLUDGE WAVE

smack_down.desc: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. If the target is in the air, it will be knocked down to the ground.
smack_down.name: SMACK DOWN

smart_strike.desc: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
smart_strike.name: SMART STRIKE

smelling_salt.desc: This attack inflicts double damage on a paralyzed foe. It also cures the foe’s paralysis, however.
smelling_salt.name: SMELLINGSALT

smog.desc: The foe is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. It may also poison the target.
smog.name: SMOG

smoke_screen.desc: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. It reduces the foe’s accuracy.
smoke_screen.name: SMOKESCREEN

snarl.desc: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.
snarl.name: SNARL

snatch.desc: The user steals the effects of any healing or stat- changing move the foe attempts to use.
snatch.name: SNATCH

snore.desc: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.
snore.name: SNORE

snowscape.desc: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.
snowscape.name: SNOWSCAPE

soak.desc: The user shoots a torrent of water that changes the target's type to Water.
soak.name: SOAK

softboiled.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP. It may also be used to heal an ally’s HP.
softboiled.name: SOFTBOILED

solar_beam.desc: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.
solar_beam.name: SOLARBEAM

sonic_boom.desc: The foe is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.
sonic_boom.name: SONICBOOM

spacial_rend.desc: The user tears the foe along with the space around it. This move has a high critical-hit ratio.
spacial_rend.name: SPACIAL REND

spark.desc: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the foe. It may also leave the target paralyzed.
spark.name: SPARK

spider_web.desc: The user ensnares the foe with a thin, gooey silk so it can’t flee from battle.
spider_web.name: SPIDER WEB

spike_cannon.desc: Sharp spikes are fired at the foe to strike two to five times in rapid succession.
spike_cannon.name: SPIKE CANNON

spikes.desc: The user lays a trap of spikes at the foe’s feet. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.
spikes.name: SPIKES

spiky_shield.desc: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker that makes direct contact.
spiky_shield.name: SPIKY SHIELD

spit_up.desc: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack.
spit_up.name: SPIT UP

spite.desc: The user looses its grudge on the move last used by the foe by cutting 4 PP from it.
spite.name: SPITE

splash.desc: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...
splash.name: SPLASH

spore.desc: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.
spore.name: SPORE

stealth_rock.desc: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the foe. The trap hurts foes that switch into battle.
stealth_rock.name: STEALTH ROCK

steel_wing.desc: The foe is hit with wings of steel. It may also raise the user’s Defense stat.
steel_wing.name: STEEL WING

sticky_web.desc: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching into battle.
sticky_web.name: STICKY WEB

stockpile.desc: The user charges up power, and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def. The move can be used three times.
stockpile.name: STOCKPILE

stomp.desc: The foe is stomped with a big foot. It may also make the target flinch.
stomp.name: STOMP

stomping_tantrum.desc: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
stomping_tantrum.name: STOMPING TANTRUM

stone_edge.desc: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.
stone_edge.name: STONE EDGE

stored_power.desc: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.
stored_power.name: STORED POWER

storm_throw.desc: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.
storm_throw.name: STORM THROW

strength.desc: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.
strength.name: STRENGTH

strength_sap.desc: The user restores its own HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. It then lowers the target's Attack stat.
strength_sap.name: STRENGTH SAP

string_shot.desc: The foe is bound with silk blown from the user’s mouth. It reduces the target’s Speed stat.
string_shot.name: STRING SHOT

struggle.desc: An attack that is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. It also hurts the user slightly.
struggle.name: STRUGGLE

struggle_bug.desc: The user attacks by struggling against opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Sp. Atk stats.
struggle_bug.name: STRUGGLE BUG

stun_spore.desc: The user scatters a cloud of paralyzing powder. It may paralyze the target.
stun_spore.name: STUN SPORE

submission.desc: The user grabs the foe and recklessly dives for the ground. It also hurts the user slightly.
submission.name: SUBMISSION

substitute.desc: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.
substitute.name: SUBSTITUTE

sucker_punch.desc: This move enables the user to attack first. It fails if the foe is not readying an attack, however.
sucker_punch.name: SUCKER PUNCH

sunny_day.desc: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.
sunny_day.name: SUNNY DAY

super_fang.desc: The user chomps hard on the foe with its sharp front fangs. It cuts the target’s HP to half.
super_fang.name: SUPER FANG

superpower.desc: The user attacks the foe with great power. However, it also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense.
superpower.name: SUPERPOWER

supersonic.desc: The user generates odd sound waves from its body. It may confuse the target.
supersonic.name: SUPERSONIC

surf.desc: It swamps the entire battlefield with a giant wave. It can also be used for crossing water.
surf.name: SURF

swagger.desc: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.
swagger.name: SWAGGER

swallow.desc: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP.
swallow.name: SWALLOW

sweet_kiss.desc: The user kisses the foe with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.
sweet_kiss.name: SWEET KISS

sweet_scent.desc: A sweet scent that lowers the foe’s evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.
sweet_scent.name: SWEET SCENT

swift.desc: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.
swift.name: SWIFT

switcheroo.desc: The user trades held items with the foe faster than the eye can follow.
switcheroo.name: SWITCHEROO

swords_dance.desc: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.
swords_dance.name: SWORDS DANCE

synthesis.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
synthesis.name: SYNTHESIS

tackle.desc: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the foe with its whole body.
tackle.name: TACKLE

tail_glow.desc: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, sharply raising its Sp. Atk stat.
tail_glow.name: TAIL GLOW

tail_whip.desc: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe less wary. The target’s Defense stat is lowered.
tail_whip.name: TAIL WHIP

tailwind.desc: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed of all party Pokémon for three turns.
tailwind.name: TAILWIND

take_down.desc: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the foe. It also damages the user a little.
take_down.name: TAKE DOWN

take_heart.desc: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
take_heart.name: TAKE HEART

taunt.desc: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for two to four turns.
taunt.name: TAUNT

tearful_look.desc: The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
tearful_look.name: TEARFUL LOOK

teeter_dance.desc: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses all the Pokémon in battle.
teeter_dance.name: TEETER DANCE

teleport.desc: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. It may also be used to warp to the last Poké Center visited.
teleport.name: TELEPORT

thief.desc: The user attacks and steals the foe’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.
thief.name: THIEF

thrash.desc: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.
thrash.name: THRASH

throat_chop.desc: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
throat_chop.name: THROAT CHOP

thunder.desc: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.
thunder.name: THUNDER

thunder_fang.desc: The user bites with electrified fangs. It may also make the foe flinch or become paralyzed.
thunder_fang.name: THUNDER FANG

thunder_punch.desc: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the target with paralysis.
thunder_punch.name: THUNDERPUNCH

thunder_shock.desc: A jolt of electricity is hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.
thunder_shock.name: THUNDERSHOCK

thunder_wave.desc: A weak electric charge is launched at the foe. It causes paralysis if it hits.
thunder_wave.name: THUNDER WAVE

thunderbolt.desc: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.
thunderbolt.name: THUNDERBOLT

tickle.desc: The user tickles the foe into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.
tickle.name: TICKLE

torment.desc: The user torments and enrages the foe, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
torment.name: TORMENT

toxic.desc: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
toxic.name: TOXIC

toxic_spikes.desc: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the foe’s feet. They poison foes that switch into battle.
toxic_spikes.name: TOXIC SPIKES

toxic_thread.desc: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.
toxic_thread.name: TOXIC THREAD

transform.desc: The user transforms into a copy of the foe right down to having the same move set.
transform.name: TRANSFORM

tri_attack.desc: The user strikes with a simultaneous three- beam attack. May also paralyze, burn, or freeze the target.
tri_attack.name: TRI ATTACK

trick.desc: The user catches the foe off guard and swaps the foe’s held item with its own.
trick.name: TRICK

trick_room.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
trick_room.name: TRICK ROOM

triple_kick.desc: A consecutive three- kick attack that becomes more powerful with each  successive hit.
triple_kick.name: TRIPLE KICK

trump_card.desc: The fewer PP this move has, the more power it has for attack.
trump_card.name: TRUMP CARD

twin_beam.desc: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
twin_beam.name: TWIN BEAM

twineedle.desc: The foe is stabbed twice by a pair of stingers. It may also poison the target.
twineedle.name: TWINEEDLE

twister.desc: The user whips up a vicious twister to tear at the foe. It may also make the foe flinch.
twister.name: TWISTER

u_turn.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
u_turn.name: U-TURN

uproar.desc: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.
uproar.name: UPROAR

vacuum_wave.desc: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the foe. This move always goes first.
vacuum_wave.name: VACUUM WAVE

venom_drench.desc: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.
venom_drench.name: VENOM DRENCH

venoshock.desc: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.
venoshock.name: VENOSHOCK

vice_grip.desc: Huge, impressive pincers grip and squeeze the foe.
vice_grip.name: VICEGRIP

vine_whip.desc: The foe is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.
vine_whip.name: VINE WHIP

vital_throw.desc: The user allows the foe to attack first. In return, this throw move is guaranteed not to miss.
vital_throw.name: VITAL THROW

volt_switch.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
volt_switch.name: VOLT SWITCH

volt_tackle.desc: The user electrifies itself, then charges at the foe. It causes considerable damage to the user as well.
volt_tackle.name: VOLT TACKLE

wake_up_slap.desc: This attack inflicts high damage on a sleeping foe. It also wakes the foe up, however.
wake_up_slap.name: WAKE-UP SLAP

water_gun.desc: The foe is blasted with a forceful shot of water.
water_gun.name: WATER GUN

water_pulse.desc: The user attacks the foe with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.
water_pulse.name: WATER PULSE

water_sport.desc: The user soaks itself with water. The move weakens Fire-type moves while the user is in the battle.
water_sport.name: WATER SPORT

water_spout.desc: The user spouts water to damage the foe. The lower the user’s HP, the less powerful it becomes.
water_spout.name: WATER SPOUT

waterfall.desc: The user charges the foe at an awesome speed. It can also be used to climb a waterfall.
waterfall.name: WATERFALL

wave_crash.desc: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.
wave_crash.name: WAVE CRASH

weather_ball.desc: An attack move that varies in power and type depending on the weather.
weather_ball.name: WEATHER BALL

whirlpool.desc: The user traps the foe inside a fast, vicious whirlpool that lasts for two to five turns.
whirlpool.name: WHIRLPOOL

whirlwind.desc: The foe is blown away, to be replaced by another Pokémon in its party. In the wild, the battle ends.
whirlwind.name: WHIRLWIND

wide_guard.desc: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.
wide_guard.name: WIDE GUARD

wild_charge.desc: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.
wild_charge.name: WILD CHARGE

will_o_wisp.desc: The user shoots a sinister, bluish white flame at the foe to inflict a burn.
will_o_wisp.name: WILL-O-WISP

wing_attack.desc: The foe is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.
wing_attack.name: WING ATTACK

wish.desc: A self-healing move. The user restores its own HP by up to half of its maximum HP in the next turn.
wish.name: WISH

withdraw.desc: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.
withdraw.name: WITHDRAW

wonder_room.desc: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.
wonder_room.name: WONDER ROOM

wood_hammer.desc: The user slams its rugged body into the foe to attack. The user also sustains serious damage.
wood_hammer.name: WOOD HAMMER

work_up.desc: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are boosted.
work_up.name: WORK UP

worry_seed.desc: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.
worry_seed.name: WORRY SEED

wrap.desc: A long body or vines are used to wrap and squeeze the foe for two to five turns.
wrap.name: WRAP

wring_out.desc: The user powerfully wrings the foe. The more HP the foe has, the greater this attack’s power.
wring_out.name: WRING OUT

x_scissor.desc: The user slashes at the foe by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.
x_scissor.name: X-SCISSOR

yawn.desc: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the foe into falling asleep on the next turn.
yawn.name: YAWN

zap_cannon.desc: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.
zap_cannon.name: ZAP CANNON

zen_headbutt.desc: The user focuses its willpower to its head and rams the foe. It may also make the target flinch.
zen_headbutt.name: ZEN HEADBUTT
